name: Walter Folger
bio: a Representative from Massachusetts; born in Nantucket, Mass., June 12, 1765; attended the public schools; studied law; admitted to the bar and practiced; member of the Massachusetts state senate 1809-1815 and in 1822; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Fifteenth Congress and reelected to the Sixteenth Congress (March 4, 1817-March 3, 1821); resumed the practice of law; died in Nantucket, Mass., September 8, 1849; interment in Friends Burying Ground.
